info.title: Chiaki-ng for Wii U
info.author: MysticFlipFlop
info.description: Next-Generation of Chiaki but for Wii U
info.details:
Have you ever wanted to remote play your PS4 or PS5 to your Wii U? No? i don't care
Here is the third public release of my chiaki-ng port for Wii U.

You can:
- Play with low latency (cant go lower because of ps4's encoding speed, should be faster on ps5)
- Zoom the screen
- Voice chat with your f o l k s
- Use a corner of your gamepad to emulate a Dualshock Touchpad
- Stream resolutions like 720p and 540p at 60 fps (540p60 5M recommended)
- Get rid of the SHARE button
- Enable or disable vsync to improve your latency
- Register your console without editing files
- Enable vibration (experimental, needs testing, my gamepad is broken)
- Choose between 3 remote play modes: Audio and video, audio only, no video/audio output

For the third public release you can't:
- Open apps with copyrighted content like Youtube because your wii u will freeze and explode
- Use gyroscope

changelog:
Changes compared to the previous version:
- Vibration added (experimental / i need testers with this implementation because my gamepad is broken)
- Fixed issue with Chiaki freezing after pressing Home button and resuming with vsync disabled 🥀
- Fixed visual bugs on the TV screen
- Now the connection screen is black and not a green so green that could burn your eyes
- Fixed issue with audio desyncing (if Chiaki detects there's an audio desync of more than 150 ms, it will resync)
- There's a new X button in settings to close ... settings.
(Feature requested by Alan_2k from my Discord server) Added option in settings named: MODO, where it gives you 3 presets:
-- Normal: Stream video and audio
-- Sin video: Stream audio only
-- Sin video/audio: Use your gamepad as a simple and heavy 0.5kg Dualshock (no audio or video output)

Known issues:
- If you try to open an app with copyrighted content, chiaki will crash and your wii u will explode
- Gyroscope not implemented
